fullPassage: One of the most powerful tools to find meaning in our lives is reflective journaling — thinking back on and writing about what has happened to us. In the 1990s, Stanford University researchers asked undergraduate students on spring break to journal about their most important personal values and their daily activities; others were asked to write about only the good things that happened to them in the day. Three weeks later, the students who had written about their values were happier, healthier, and more confident about their ability to handle stress than the ones who had only focused on the good stuff. By reflecting on how their daily activities supported their values, students had gained a new perspective on those activities and choices. Little stresses and hassles were now demonstrations of their values in action. Suddenly, their lives were full of meaningful activities. And all they had to do was reflect and write about it — positively reframing their experiences with their personal values.

det.korean: (A) powerful=강력한, (B) happier=더 행복한, (C) meaningful=의미 있는. 성찰 저널은 강력한 도구이고, 가치를 쓴 학생들이 더 행복했으며, 삶이 의미 있는 활동으로 가득 찼다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① powerful - happier - meaningful: 강력한(powerful) 도구, 더 행복한(happier) 학생들, 의미 있는(meaningful) 활동. 원문 일치 ←정답
❌ ② weak - happier - meaningful: (A) weak(약한)은 '가장 강력한 도구'라는 문맥에 반대
❌ ③ powerful - sadder - meaningful: (B) sadder(더 슬픈)는 '더 행복했다'는 문맥에 반대
❌ ④ powerful - happier - meaningless: (C) meaningless(무의미한)는 '의미 있는 활동으로 가득 찼다'는 문맥에 반대
det.tip: 강력한(powerful) 도구 → 더 행복한(happier) → 의미 있는(meaningful) 활동

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "feeling sure about your own ability to do things well"

det.korean: confident: 자신의 능력을 잘 해낼 수 있다고 확신하는(자신 있는)
det.analysis:
❌ ① curious: 호기심 있는. 정의와 무관
❌ ② nervous: 불안한. 정의와 반대
❌ ③ careless: 부주의한. 정의와 무관
✅ ④ confident: 자신 있는. 자기 능력을 확신하는 감정이라는 정의에 부합 ←정답
det.tip: confident = feeling sure about your own ability (자신 있는)

questions.passage: Three weeks later, the students who had written about their values were __________ (happy), healthier, and more confident about their ability to handle stress than the ones who had only focused on the good stuff.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 형용사 happy(행복한)를 비교급 happier(더 행복한)로 변환. 뒤에 'than the ones ~(~한 사람들보다)'가 있으므로 비교급이 필요하고, healthier, more confident와 나란히 비교급으로 연결된다.
det.tip: happy → happier (than ~ 비교구문, '~보다 더 행복한')

questions.passage: Little stresses and hassles were now demonstrations of their values in action. Suddenly, their lives were full of __________ (meaning) activities.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어) (영어로)

det.analysis: 명사 meaning(의미)을 형용사 meaningful(의미 있는)로 변환. 바로 뒤 명사 activities(활동)를 꾸며야 하므로 형용사 형태가 필요하다. '-ful'을 붙여 '~로 가득한'의 의미를 만든다.
det.tip: meaning(명사) → meaningful(형용사). activities를 꾸미는 형용사

questions.passage: One of the most powerful tools to find meaning in our lives is reflective journaling — thinking back on and writing about what has happened to us. In the 1990s, Stanford University researchers asked undergraduate students on spring break to journal about their most important personal values and their daily activities; others were asked to write about only the good things that happened to them in the day. Three weeks later, the students who had written about their values were happier, healthier, and more confident about their ability to __________ than the ones who had only focused on the good stuff. By reflecting on how their daily activities supported their values, students had gained a new perspective on those activities and choices. Little stresses and hassles were now demonstrations of their values in action. Suddenly, their lives were full of meaningful activities. And all they had to do was reflect and write about it — positively reframing their experiences with their personal values.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 가치에 대해 쓴 학생들은 스트레스를 다루는(handle stress) 능력에 더 자신 있었다
det.analysis:
✅ ① handle stress: 스트레스를 다루다. 성찰 저널이 스트레스 대처 능력에 대한 자신감을 높였다는 연구 결과에 부합 ←정답
❌ ② avoid all work: 모든 일을 피하다. 본문에 없는 내용
❌ ③ earn more money: 돈을 더 벌다. 본문 주제와 무관
❌ ④ sleep much longer: 더 오래 자다. 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: more confident about their ability to ______ → handle stress (스트레스를 다루다)

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 그들이 한 일은 성찰하고 쓰는 것뿐이었다 — 개인의 가치로 경험을 긍정적으로 재구성하면서(positively reframing their experiences)

❌ ③ completely ignoring their feelings: 감정을 완전히 무시하다. 성찰의 취지와 반대
❌ ④ carefully counting their mistakes: 실수를 세다. 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: reflect and write about it — ______ → positively reframing their experiences
